title: Tile Shift
gameplaySummary: What Makes It Unique Tile Shift must be clearly different from all nearby modes: Tile Shift must be clearly different from all nearby modes: unlike Score Attack, opportunities are often created rather than discoveredunlike Combo Rush, board manipulation matters more than solving cadenceunlike Clear Rush, the board is not simply being cleanedunlike Spatial Spin, the emphasis is whole-line or structural shifting, not rotational geometryunlike RuleBreaker, the board rules do not mutate constantlyunlike Number Crunch, the challenge is spatial, not arithmetic unlike Score Attack, opportunities are often created rather than discovered | Win: Win Condition A player wins by: A player wins by:

tiles.name: Empty Cell
tiles.notes: Base board cell. Dark background with subtle grid line. Must have hover state.

tiles.name: Source Node
tiles.notes: Energy emitter tile. Glowing cyan aperture. Pulse animation on active.

tiles.name: Destination Node
tiles.notes: Energy sink tile. Completion state triggers success flash.

tiles.name: Blocked Cell
tiles.notes: Non-traversable board cell. Distinct from empty cell silhouette.

tiles.name: Pressure Zone
tiles.notes: Board area with pressure escalation. Tint escalation from normal → red.

pieces.name: Straight Pipe
pieces.notes: Core straight segment. Flow direction must be readable. Rotation = 2 orientations.

pieces.name: Corner Pipe
pieces.notes: 90° bend. Rotation = 4 orientations. Flow curve must be readable inside.

pieces.name: T-Junction Pipe
pieces.notes: Three-way connector. Split-flow animation must show branching energy.

pieces.name: Cross Junction
pieces.notes: Four-way connector. Two independent flow channels must be visually distinct.

pieces.name: Locked Pipe Segment
pieces.notes: Cannot be rotated until unlocked. Lock icon visible. Unlock is animated.

mechanics.name: Tile Rotation
mechanics.description: Player taps/clicks to rotate pipe pieces 90° at a time.

mechanics.name: Pressure Buildup
mechanics.description: Unrouted segments accumulate pressure, escalating toward burst.

mechanics.name: Live Flow Propagation
mechanics.description: Energy visibly flows from source to destination in real time.

mechanics.name: Routing Score
mechanics.description: Score accumulates per routed segment, route length, and uptime.

effects.name: Pipe Burst
effects.notes: Destructive explosion from segment center. Cyan → orange → white → fade.

effects.name: Flow Surge
effects.notes: Single bright pulse running through completed route. Reinforces success.

effects.name: Route Completion Flash
effects.notes: Full route lights up cyan → white → settled glow. Brief and satisfying.

effects.name: Pressure Warning Pulse
effects.notes: Repeating warning pulse overlay on tile. Red-amber ring animation.

effects.name: Connection Snap
effects.trigger: player rotates piece to valid connection
effects.notes: Tiny satisfying snap feedback. Brief cyan spark at connection points.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: this.load.spritesheet() in scene preload; individual frames drawn per cell
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Row 0: empty cell variants (default, hover, selected). Row 1: source node states (unpressurized, active, pulsing, overloaded). Row 2: destination node states (unfulfilled, receiving, satisfied, overflow). All cells: 128×128px, transparent bg, dark navy base, cyan accent energy.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Source/destination nodes must be immediately distinguishable from connectors. Node aperture must be clearly directional.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: spritesheet with named animation regions per pipe type × state
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Consistent pipe diameter across all piece types. Flow shown as luminous cyan energy travelling through the pipe interior. Pressure state: cyan → amber with pulsing glow. Burst: violent pipe rupture, debris, energy discharge — orange/white FX.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Pipe openings must be clearly visible as half-circles at tile edges. Flow direction animated from entry opening to exit opening. Empty pipe must contrast against board background.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: blended additive overlay on flowing pipe sprites
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Pure additive glow layer. Electric cyan to white center. Soft pulsing brightness variation across 8 frames. No hard edges.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Glow must not obscure pipe shape or connection openings.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: played once at pipe burst location, centered on tile
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Energetic decompression explosion. Starts cyan core, expands to orange/amber shockwave, fragments of pipe debris scatter, ends with white flash then alpha fade. Frames slightly larger than pipe tile (192px) to allow FX overflow. No excessive particle clouds — contained destructive burst.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Burst must be visually dramatic enough to communicate failure. Must not persist long enough to obscure neighboring tiles during gameplay.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: looped overlay on pipe tiles approaching burst state
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Red-amber pulsing ring overlay, centered on tile. Brightness escalates from frame 0 to 4, then fades back. No opaque fill — ring only, transparent interior.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Must be visible over both empty and flowing pipe states.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: played once at connection point when valid rotation is made
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Small 4-point star spark in bright cyan. Flash and fade in 6 frames. Clean, crisp, brief. No lingering glow. Single burst point.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Must be small enough not to compete with flow animation. Additive blend mode.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: played along each route tile simultaneously when route is completed
spriteSheets.styleNotes: White-cyan pulse that runs through the pipe like a wave. Sharp leading edge, fast fade trail. Non-destructive — pipe remains visible beneath.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: The route flash must visually reinforce the "this connected" moment without distracting from ongoing play.
